items.title: Last day to file objection (Widerspruch) against the refusal of the resident parking permit
items.quote: Möchten Sie die Entscheidung anfechten, erheben Sie Widerspruch – innerhalb eines Monats, gerechnet ab der Bekanntgabe, schriftlich, elektronisch mit qualifizierter Signatur oder zur Niederschrift bei der Stadt Beispielingen, Marktstraße 2, 70597 Beispielingen.
items.computation: Letter dated 2025-08-06; the posting date is not stated, so I assume it was posted that day. The letter says a posted notice counts as given on the fourth day after posting: 2025-08-06 + 4 days = 2025-08-10 (Sunday). The fiction of delivery still applies on a Sunday. The period is one month from Bekanntgabe. The event day is not counted (§ 187 (1) BGB), so the period ends on the same numbered day of the next month (§ 188 (2) BGB): 2025-09-10. That is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in BW, so no extension under § 193 BGB applies. The objection must reach the city by then.

warnings: The letter does not state the date it was posted; the deadline assumes posting on the letter date 06.08.2025. If it was posted later, the deadline moves later, but file by 10.09.2025 to be safe.
The objection must reach the city by the deadline (in writing, with a qualified electronic signature, or recorded in person); plain email is not sufficient.
